description: This file defines the 'Voucher' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Checkout' namespace. It provides methods for managing vouchers, such as adding, deleting, disabling, and retrieving vouchers and their histories in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Represents the Voucher model handling voucher data and operations within the checkout process.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Inserts a new voucher record into the database with associated order ID and data.

methods.name: deleteVouchersByOrderId
methods.description: Removes all vouchers associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: disableVoucher
methods.description: Disables (sets status to 0) for vouchers linked to a specific order ID.

methods.name: getVoucher
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a voucher given its code.

methods.name: getVoucherByCode
methods.description: Fetches voucher details from the database using its code.

methods.name: getVoucherTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total amount used or associated with a specific voucher.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history record for a voucher, recording a transaction or change.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all voucher history records associated with a specific order ID.
